newsitem.title: UK: BA World Cargo USAir Cargo in Toronto link.
newsitem.headline: BA World Cargo USAir Cargo in Toronto link.

text.p: British Airways PLc's World Cargo division and USAir Cargo are now located under one roof at Toronto Pearson International airport -- providing 'one-stop shopping' for shippers and forwarders, BA World Cargo said in a statement.
All sales and ground handling operations and staff of both airlines are based at a single site within the 15,400 sq.ft warehouse facility leased by BA World Cargo.
The partners also share the same ground handling agent, Aerolink, it added.

BA operates a daily Boeing 747 service between Toronto and London, with a second daily 747 service on Thursdays and Saturday during the summer months. The airline also operate a daily Boeing 757 service to Birmingham via New York's JFK.

USAir operates a total of 21 flights from Toronto each day, to a number of U.S. cities including Pittsburg, Washington, Philadelphia, Baltimore, Cleveland and Indianapolis. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
